title.narrative: USAID Inform Asia Associate Award #2 - Technical assistance to strengthen malaria surveillance and the use of strategic information for malaria programming

description.narrative: (USAID Regional Development Mission-Asia (RDM/A)): USAID Inform Asia provides technical assistance to the national malaria program in Thailand to: 1) strengthen malaria surveillance systems for detection, notification, and response to all malaria cases; 2) evaluate malaria elimination approaches and strategies for implementation and scale-up; and 3) generate and use strategic information including routine data from anti-malarial drug therapeutic efficacy monitoring and documentation write-ups. Technical assistance will result in the development of key strategic information products, such as user-friendly informatics dashboards, technical assessments, advocacy briefs, and publications to inform relevant stakeholders and decision-makers. USAID expects that by the end of this award, Thailand's national malaria program will have increased technical capacity at national and subnational levels to use strategic information to plan, budget, implement, and monitor data-driven, technically sound, and cost-effective malaria programming that maximizes disease impact-a cornerstone in the road to a malaria-free Thailand by 2024. With FY 2022 funds, the activity will focus on providing monitoring and evaluation, data analysis for verification of subnational malaria elimination, prevention of re-introduction strategies that includes climate and environmental factors, and strengthening government staff capacity on data use and wider dissemination of lessons learned from Thailand's malaria elimination efforts. Achieving malaria elimination addresses global and U.S. national security priorities as it helps to create a more stable and prosperous region that advances American security and economic interests as well as enhancing regional prosperity and good governance. ...
